k-kinzal/php-ai-toolkitリポジトリを確認して下記のいずれかを実施してください
1. mainのCIが落ちていれば通るように修正する
2. RenovateのPRでコンフリクトが発生していれば解消する
3. RenovateのPRのCIが落ちていれば解消する
4. ローカルのmainで未プッシュがあればプッシュする

このプロジェクトはmainブランチで作業を行っているプロジェクトです。mainで修正を行い、mainでコミット、プッシュを実施ください。
ただし、2、3に関してはRenovate PR自体を修正し、PRのマージまで進めてください。
リポジトリの状態（ローカル main の未プッシュ、main の CI、Renovate PR）をまず確認します。

input.command: git fetch origin --prune 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "--- status"; git status -sb | head -5; echo "--- unpushed"; git log origin/main..main --oneline; echo "--- main CI"; gh run list --branch main --limit 5 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,name,headSha,createdAt --jq '.[] | "\(.databaseId) \(.status) \(.conclusion) \(.name) \(.headSha[0:8]) \(.createdAt)"'; echo "--- PRs"; gh pr list --state open --json number,title,headRefName,author,mergeable,mergeStateStatus --jq '.[] | "\(.number) [\(.author.login)] \(.mergeable)/\(.mergeStateStatus) \(.headRefName) :: \(.title)"'

--- mutation.yml
name: Mutation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  COMPOSER_ROOT_VERSION: dev-main

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  mutation:
    name: Mutation testing (${{ matrix.package }})
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/${{ matrix.package }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package:
          - decisions-lint
          - docgen-php
          - doctest-php
          - guard-php
          - phpstan-ai-formatter
          - phpstan-guard-rules
          - phpunit-ai-reporter
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G

      - name: Validate the Composer manifest and lock file
        run: composer validate --strict --no-check-publish

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          composer check-platform-reqs
          vendor/bin/infection --version

      - name: Run mutation testing
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/infection \
            --configuration=infection.json5 \
            --with-uncovered \
            --threads=max \
            --only-covering-test-cases \
            --test-framework-extra-args="--no-extensions --enforce-time-limit --default-time-limit=2" \
            --min-msi=0 \
            --min-covered-msi=0 \
            --no-progress \
            --logger-github

      - name: Reject skipped mutants
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=1G -r '
            $path = "build/infection/infection.json";
            $report = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if (($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] ?? null) !== 0) {
                fwrite(STDERR, $path . " skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                exit(1);
            }
          '

      - name: Create or update the mutation score issue
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          PACKAGE: ${{ matrix.package }}
          MIN_MSI: '80'
          MIN_COVERED_MSI: '80'
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');
            const name = process.env.PACKAGE;
            const minMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_MSI);
            const minCoveredMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_COVERED_MSI);
            const file = path.join('packages', name, 'build/infection/infection.json');
            if (!fs.existsSync(file)) {
              throw new Error(`Infection did not write the report for ${name}.`);
            }
            const { stats } = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
            for (const value of [stats.msi, stats.coveredCodeMsi, minMsi, minCoveredMsi]) {
              if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 100) {
                throw new Error(`Infection must report valid MSI percentages and thresholds for ${name}.`);
              }
            }
            const below = stats.msi < minMsi || stats.coveredCodeMsi < minCoveredMsi;
            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const marker = `<!-- ${context.workflow}:${name}:msi -->`;
            const title = `[${context.workflow}] ${name}: Mutation score below threshold`;
            const body = [
              marker,
              `Scheduled mutation testing on the default branch is below the required score.`,
              '',
              '| Package | MSI | Covered MSI | Required MSI | Required covered MSI |',
              '| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |',
              `| ${name} | ${stats.msi}% | ${stats.coveredCodeMsi}% | ${minMsi}% | ${minCoveredMsi}% |`,
              '',
              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              `Run and mutation reports: ${run}`,
              `Run attempt: ${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
              '',
              `The score is reported here without failing the workflow. Read escaped.log in the mutation-reports-${name} artifact for the mutants no test objected to.`
            ].join('\n');
            await core.summary
              .addHeading(`Mutation testing: ${name}`)
              .addRaw(`${name}: MSI ${stats.msi}% (required: ${minMsi}%), covered MSI ${stats.coveredCodeMsi}% (required: ${minCoveredMsi}%).`)
              .write();
            if (!below) return;
            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
              ...context.repo, state: 'all', per_page: 100
            });
            const existing = issues.find(issue => !issue.pull_request && (
              issue.body?.includes(marker) || issue.title === title
            ));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.update({ ...context.repo, issue_number: existing.number, body });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body });
            }

      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: mutation-reports-${{ matrix.package }}
          path: packages/${{ matrix.package }}/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
